title: 'I Hit a Nerve': Stephen King Criticized for Epstein Post - NewsBreak
text: The Department of Justice (DOJ) and the FBI have claimed there is no evidence of a “client list” related to convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. They have also deemed his death a suicide, dismissing foul play theories. Author Stephen King drew backlash after likening the rumored client list to mythical figures such as the Tooth Fairy and Santa Claus. King wrote that Epstein trafficked young girls and deemed the existence of a client folder doubtful, calling it conspiracy fodder. He acknowledged the online pushback, comparing public interest in Epstein’s case to UFOs. He noted, “Boy, I hit a nerve with that Epstein post. The ‘list’ is like UFOs: Everyone knows someone who’s seen one.” King added that the Epstein client list is real, just like the Tooth Fairy and Santa Claus. He drew backlash online for these comments, with users questioning his motives. King had previously written that a lot of powerful people were breathing sighs of relief over Epstein’s ‘suicide.’ President Donald Trump has also dismissed concern surrounding the case, blaming Democrats for pushing the narrative. He stated that “The Radical Left Democrats have hit pay dirt, again!” Trump added that just like with the FAKE and fully discredited Steele Dossier, the lying 51 ‘Intelligence’ Agents, the Laptop from Hell, and even the Russia, Russia, Russia Scam itself, these scams and hoaxes are all the Democrats are good at. Trump wrote that their new SCAM is what he will forever call the Jeffrey Epstein Hoax. He expressed that his past supporters have bought into this ‘[expletive],’ hook, line, and sinker, stating they haven’t learned their lesson and that he doesn’t want their support anymore. John Baker covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
